prompt.build:
Build me an app: {description}

Save it in {where}, as a draft with a few rows of sample data so I can try it. Don’t publish it: I will try the draft and publish it myself. When it is saved, tell me in plain words what the app can read and change, and anything it needs that I should know about.
prompt.edit:
Change my app “{name}” (app id {app}, in space id {space}): {description}

Change its draft only. The published release must keep working as it is until I publish the draft. Tell me what you changed and anything new it needs.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor login
twoFactor.intro: After your password, log in with a six-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone. Signing in with a provider doesn't ask for it: the provider decides that.
